cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plan exceeded the budget. You agreed to announce the cut; I'll check your wording before the meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only went over by two hundred pounds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say two hundred, not 'only'. Start with what the cut removes; people need the consequence before your explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You know how to say it. Could you make the announcement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll mark the pauses on your copy. Your name stays beside 'presenter'. Read me the first sentence now; we can correct it before you face them.

reason: Let A accept the expertise compliment by coaching B while retaining B's promised public responsibility.
